summary: Lattice observation tower in Vernon Parish, Louisiana, mapped by volunteers and named on a 2003 map; no build date, agency or current condition found.

evidence.supports: Station record is from the National Geodetic Survey
The station record has no description
The string given as agency is a land-survey location
OpenStreetMap names the tower Kurthwood Fire Tower
OpenStreetMap tags the tower construction as lattice
OpenStreetMap tags the tower type as observation
Community renamed Kurthwood after Joseph H. Kurth built a mill, per one report
evidence.quote: One report has Nona was renamed Kurthwood when Joseph H. Kurth built a lumber mill at Nona about 1920.

evidence.supports: Nona was a sawmill town in Vernon Parish
evidence.quote: Nona was a saw mill town in Vernon Parish.

evidence.supports: The 2003 map description names the Kurthwood Fire Tower
evidence.quote: The presence of the Kurthwood Fire Tower underscores the region's historical reliance on forest management and lookout infrastructure.

evidence.supports: The map's feature index lists the Kurthwood Fire Tower under landmarks

corrections.why: That value is a land-survey location (township 4 North, range 8 West, section 26) printed on the National Geodetic Survey station record. The sources name no managing agency.

notes_for_editor: Very thin. The brief's agency value '4N-8W-Sec.26' is a survey location, see corrections. Sources are an NGS station record with no description, a volunteer OpenStreetMap node, a Wikipedia note about the community name, and a map-aggregator description of a 2003 USGS sheet whose wording reads as generated, so treat it as a lead. A Pastmaps 2024 sheet snippet mentions a 'Kurthwood Fire Tower Rd', which was not read in full. The 1994 Kisatchie history names a tower on the Vernon Ranger District (Whisky Chitto) but not Kurthwood. Check Vernon Parish and Kisatchie or LDAF records before publishing. The anyplaceamerica.com page for this tower returned HTTP 403.
